audit.why: champ-data/_kits/swain.json flags revealsStealth on Vision of Empire. champ-data/_kits/aurora.json gives Across the Veil invisibility and no untargetability anywhere. edits.before: Late-game Swain is the scarier champion in a stand-still teamfight — his R is a sustained AoE drain that heals him through your poke once he's stacked souls and built tanky AP. Your edge is the early-mid lead you should already have, plus your R untargetability and W mobility to pick him before he transforms. Don't get dragged into a long drain fight where he out-sustains you; flank, bait his E defensively, and burst him with Q before the drain grinds you down. If the game goes even, his scaling reclaims it.

notes:
THE FIND: Vision of Empire has the revealsStealth flag. Across the Veil's invisibility is Aurora's escape, her repositioning tool and half her trade pattern, and Swain holds the one button in this matchup that cancels it — and the entry never says so once. A reader is currently being told to leap into the spirit realm as a dodge for the root; inside a Vision of Empire zone that leap accomplishes nothing.

The chart was inverted end to end: four stages to Swain and zero to Aurora in a 58.18% lane, while every one of the whys argued the opposite. I flipped both layers and raised diff/diffRating with them, since 'EVEN 6/10' cannot survive next to the corrected chart.

'Untargetable' appears again (spikes[1], mid, late) — fourth matchup in my slice. Repo-wide grep of champ-data/content/aurora.js for 'untargetab' is overdue.

'Between the Worlds' (extra 'the') again in the full layer.

full.focus.text is 'Swain Demonic Ascension' with letters ['R']. That is the wrong ability to print on a loading screen for a lane fought at levels 2-6; Nevermove ('E') is the one that decides it. I did not propose the swap because focus.text and focus.letters have to move together and I cannot verify the renderer's token set.

QUESTION FOR YOU, recorded rather than guessed: Swain's Nevermove is a projectile (kit flag). Whether Aurora's Between Worlds rift teleport can be used to cross out of the root's return path mid-flight is an animation-priority question Riot's text does not answer, and it would change the level-6 advice materially. I left the level-6 text on the safe framing.
